opening.argument: The speaker presents a Bitcoin mining business opportunity built around purchasing a specialized machine, asserting that “if you buy that robot, you will get those Bitcoins very cheaply.” She does not describe this merely as general cryptocurrency information: she frames it as “this business opportunity,” says her team is providing tools to show it to more people, and offers a link for further engagement. Together, these statements connect a proposed purchase to cheaply obtained Bitcoins, invite viewers to join or benefit from the opportunity, and actively direct them toward additional contact. That combination establishes a solicitation centered on paid mining or node returns.
